goal.decided: At the user's word, the AI runs many claude -p tasks unattended at night without using up the daytime usage window, and each task finishes past the usage limit or is logged as given up. In the morning, the AI reads from the log which tasks finished and which were given up, tells the user, and takes their results into the main session, and an AI that runs another plugin calls its wait-and-resume part instead of writing its own.

decisions.decided: The AI that the user instructs: the user tells it what to run overnight, and the AI arranges the queue and its tasks.

At the user's word, the AI lists the night's tasks with a start time and starts them, and they go on after the conversation closes. A task that hits the usage limit waits until the limit resets and resumes. In the morning, the AI reads the log, tells the user which tasks finished and which were given up, and takes their results into the main session. An AI that runs another plugin calls the wait-and-resume part instead of writing its own.
